mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, user_id, first_name, last_name, title, specialty, bio, phone, address, city, latitude, longitude, active, created_at, updated_at, (CAST(6371.0 AS DOUBLE) * ACOS( LEAST(CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE), CAST( COS(RADIANS(CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE))) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(CAST(#{lng} AS DOUBLE))) + SIN(RADIANS(CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE))) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) AS DOUBLE ) ) )) AS distance_km FROM professional_profiles WHERE active = TRUE AND latitude BETWEEN CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE) - CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) / CAST(111.320 AS DOUBLE) AND CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE) + CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) / CAST(111.320 AS DOUBLE) AND longitude BETWEEN CAST(#{lng} AS DOUBLE) - CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) / (CAST(111.320 AS DOUBLE) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE)))) AND CAST(#{lng} AS DOUBLE) + CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) / (CAST(111.320 AS DOUBLE) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE)))) AND (#{specialty} IS NULL OR LOWER(specialty) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{specialty}), '%')) ) AS nearby WHERE distance_km <= CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) ORDER BY distance_km ASC
